summary.text: Ross Lockhart is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 45, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A fourth-generation farmer, he lists healthcare costs, public school funding, wages and housing among the issues he wants to address.

paragraphs.text: Ross Lockhart graduated from Northern Cass Public School, earned a bachelor's degree from Minnesota State University, Moorhead in 2003 and a graduate degree from the University of Kent at Canterbury in 2005.
His career experience includes working as a farmer.
Lockhart advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has served as a volunteer firefighter, a township officer, a farmers' cooperative board president and a coach.

He said he wants to stand up for working people against powerful corporate interests and listed unaffordable healthcare, public school funding cuts, wages and housing among the challenges facing the state.
